answer: Prayers & Duties >> Taharah (Purity) Question ID: 16132 Country: India Title: ek mard ke liye band bathroom me nange ho kar nahana kya jayaj hai? Question: ek mard ke liye band bathroom me nange ho kar nahana kya jayaj hai? Answer ID: 16132 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1541/1232/L=1430) It is allowable to have bath naked in bathroom. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
